1. `DERIVATION_SURFACE = ['.github/workflows', '.github/actions', 'package.json', 'scripts']` (L15461); the STALE reading is `git diff --name-only HEAD...origin/main -- <surface>` (L15548) and prints every changed path under it as 「file(s) it derives from」 (L15700). `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/core.json` and `react.json` exist and are regenerated on ui landings; grep the file for every `scripts/` path it actually reads or imports when deriving (`readFileSync`, `import`, `existsSync`, glob roots) — that set is the honest derivation surface; the card measured the derived set unchanged (52) across a sentinel-only change.
2. The seat measured this very warning at 2026-10-27T04:58Z on a stale checkout: 「107 file(s) it derives from CHANGED」 listing `.github/workflows/**` first — a real case the fix must keep STALE.
3. Last three landings on the file: #26383 (ui/scripts suite derivation), #26339, #26266 — base on a tree carrying `55f845ad` or later; no open PR touches `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (scan at 2026-10-27T05:40Z; #26071's PRs touch workflow files and the gates that NAME them, not this reading).

### Card-specific clauses

- Gates: derive with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) on your final tree, run each locally (exit code captured before any pipe), reconcile with `--ran`; `check:pm-dispatch-gates` self-test must carry one new case per direction (sentinel-only change ⇒ FRESH; a workflow/package.json/derived-script change ⇒ STALE); long gates detached under `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` with `OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT=issue-26334`. ⛔ Do not wait for CI after the PR opens.
- PR body: line 1 `Fixes #26334` (behind the harness's two attribution lines), then `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial, the six-line `## 维护者速读` exactly as `os-dev.md` 285–289 require (Tier S: 需要你做的 = 无,席位落地), then What changes, Tests (the two new self-test cases named), Acceptance notes, Verification (the `--ran` reading before and after on a deliberately stale tree, quoted). ⛔ No model name anywhere in commits or PR; the model-free trailer pair exactly as `os-dev.md` / `AGENTS.md` spell them.
- ⛔ Never write the card's labels or assignee. ⛔ No GitHub MCP tools, reads included.
- Final report: the JSON exactly per `os-dev.md` (issue comment on #26334 whose first line is `os-dev-report`, then the same JSON as your hand-back message to the seat thread), with `deviations` and `out_of_scope_findings` (class + reach + evidence + dedupe words + carrier). Hand back: one message to the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 naming the PR number, the head sha, the report comment id and the premise verdict; then stay subscribed to the PR for the contract review's verdict and a possible patch round.
